description: This class is an implementation of the UserService interface, providing user management functionalities such as fetching, deleting, listing, and saving User entities. It interacts with the UserDao for database operations and uses EmailService for email functionalities (though not shown in current methods).

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements user-related business logic, including CRUD operations and retrieval of users based on various criteria.

methods.name: UserServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes UserDao and passes it to superclass.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity based on username.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a User entity after retrieving it by ID.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Lists all users, handling exceptions with ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists users associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new User or updates an existing User based on the presence of an ID.
